# 90-Minute Monday Team Meeting Plan for Austin

A focused weekly meeting works best here: keep KPI review tight, spend most time on blockers and decisions, then end with clear owners and deadlines. This plan fits a 6-person team across sales, operations, and support.

## Weekly Meeting Agenda and Time Breakdown

| Time | Segment | Purpose | Output |
|---|---|---|---|
| 10 min | KPI snapshot | Review the 5–7 most important metrics | Shared view of performance trends |
| 20 min | Wins and risks | Surface short updates from each function | Fast context on what changed |
| 30 min | Blockers and decisions | Resolve issues that need cross-team input | Decisions, owners, next steps |
| 20 min | Action items | Assign tasks, dates, dependencies | Clear action list with owners |
| 10 min | Wrap-up | Confirm recap, deadlines, and next meeting | Final alignment and close |

### Suggested Monday Cadence
- **10:00–10:10** KPI review
- **10:10–10:30** Department updates
- **10:30–11:00** Blockers and decisions
- **11:00–11:20** Action assignment
- **11:20–11:30** Closing recap

## Note-Taking Structure for Fast Follow-Through

Use one shared meeting note with these sections:

### 1) Meeting Details
- Date:
- Time:
- Attendees:
- Facilitator:
- Note-taker:

### 2) KPI Review
- Metric:
- Current value:
- Last week:
- Trend:
- Comment:

### 3) Department Updates
- Sales:
- Operations:
- Support:

### 4) Blockers / Decisions
- Issue:
- Impact:
- Decision needed:
- Owner:
- Due date:

### 5) Action Items
- Action:
- Owner:
- Deadline:
- Status:

### 6) Parking Lot
- Topics to revisit later:
- Deferred decisions:
- Follow-up owner:

### 7) Closeout
- Key decisions made:
- Top 3 priorities for next week:
- Reminder sent: Yes/No

## Follow-Up Reminder Template

Subject: Weekly Team Meeting Recap — Actions Due

Hi team,

Thanks for the productive meeting today. Here’s the recap of decisions and next steps:

Key decisions:
- [Decision 1]
- [Decision 2]

Action items:
- [Action item] — Owner: [Name] — Due: [Date]
- [Action item] — Owner: [Name] — Due: [Date]
- [Action item] — Owner: [Name] — Due: [Date]

Open blockers:
- [Blocker 1]
- [Blocker 2]

Please update your items before our next Monday meeting at 10:00 AM CT.

Thanks,
[Your Name]

## Quick Actions

Action: [Button: Copy agenda] https://example.com
Action: [Button: Copy reminder] https://example.com

## Sources

- Time zone reference: https://www.timeanddate.com/time/zones/ct
- Weekly meeting best practices: https://hbr.org/2021/03/how-to-run-a-more-effective-meeting
